meta.title: Add pagination support for template gallery with 248+ templates
meta.body_summary: Add client-side pagination to the template gallery displaying 20 templates per page with navigation controls, replacing the all-at-once rendering that caused performance issues with 248+ templates.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot added pagination to reduce DOM rendering; minor edge-case text fixes and cleanup applied in-review before merge.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 250 changed lines, this is a small-to-medium edit by absolute volume, focused on one component. It fits a typical incremental frontend performance fix and was merged after addressing review feedback.

review_details.concern_detail: Reviewer hemarina requested singular/zero template count display ('Viewing 1 template' instead of 'Viewing 1-1 of 1 template') and removal of an unnecessary console.log for WcpConsent; also corrected changelog issue reference from 378 to 631.
review_details.performance_claim: Pagination renders 20 templates instead of 248, reducing browser load and improving page performance.
review_details.antipattern_addressed: unbounded_dom_rendering (prior behavior; not in taxonomy enum)

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Frontend pagination feature with smart ellipsis is within Copilot capability; merge required small correctness fixes and text adjustments but no benchmark evidence.

detection_detail.code_reading: hemarina manually reviewed and requested edge-case text fixes, console.log removal, and changelog correction.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body includes manual test instructions and screenshots but no quantitative performance improvement numbers.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: All reviewer comments were addressed by Copilot with separate commits before merge; no revert occurred.

core_change_summary.description: In ShowcaseCardPage.tsx, add pagination state (currentPage, itemsPerPage=20), slice filtered templates, reset page on filter change, and render PaginationControls with ellipsis logic; update template count text for edge cases (zero/single templates).
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Navbar change removed a debug console.log for WcpConsent check; changelog added pagination feature entry.
